remarks: Set in one of Springdale's most sought-after communities, this sunny end unit offers privacy, space, and a layout designed for everyday living and easy entertaining. The main level features a welcoming living room with a wood-burning fireplace and direct access to a large, fully fenced patio, perfect for outdoor dining, relaxing, or weekend grilling.  The kitchen has been thoughtfully updated with a new stainless steel sink and KRAUS touch faucet, complemented by all LG stainless steel appliances, including a double oven that makes cooking and hosting a breeze. Central air throughout all levels ensures year-round comfort, while the finished lower level provides flexible space ideal for a family room, home office, gym, or media room.  An exterior 240V outlet offers convenient EV charging, adding modern functionality to this already well-rounded home. Tucked within a quiet, peaceful setting, the location remains incredibly convenient with easy access to the Merritt Parkway, Springdale and Talmadge Hill train stations, shopping, dining, public transportation, Twin Rinks, Woodway Country Club, and downtown Stamford.  A rare opportunity to enjoy low-maintenance living with thoughtful upgrades in a tranquil setting, all while staying close to everything Springdale and Stamford have to offer.
